description: Candidate passes /health but business traffic fails, producing a high Prometheus error rate.

scenario_definition.traffic_pattern: Send repeated /pay requests mixed with /refund requests; expect /pay to return HTTP 500 while /health still passes.
scenario_definition.proves: BDI can roll back from telemetry-derived production instability that a health-check-only pipeline would miss.
